## 2. ⭐ THE DEPLOYABILITY TABLE — precision WITH recall, and BOTH denominators

*`n_alarm` is what precision divides by; `n_pos` is what recall divides by; both are printed. The chance-referenced **lift** is the axis that dispersion cannot game — a random score sits at 1.000 on it, so `< 1.000` is a genuine below-chance verdict.*
